Home.heroSubtitle: Record once, present it forever. Schedule automated sessions, simulate live chat, and sell your products with timed CTAs — with no need for a real live stream.
Home.trial: 7-day free trial — no credit card required
Home.featuresSubtitle: One platform, with no need to stream live every time.

video.title: Record once, present it forever
video.description: Every visitor watches your webinar as if it were live, with a locked player so they can't skip ahead or download the video.

scheduling.title: Scheduling your way
scheduling.description: Recurring fixed times, instant start ("start now"), or both combined in the same webinar.

chat.title: Simulated live chat
chat.description: Timed messages and a viewer counter that make the event feel real, with no manual moderation.

ctas.title: Timed CTAs
ctas.description: Links, banners, and polls that appear at the exact second in the video to sell at just the right moment.

analytics.title: Per-webinar analytics
analytics.description: Registrants, real attendance, retention curve, clicks per CTA, and poll results, all in one place.

branding.title: Your brand, not ours
branding.description: Your own logo and colors on registration, the room, and the automated confirmation and reminder emails.

Home.howItWorksSubtitle: From recording to your first sale, in three steps.

record.title: Record your presentation
record.description: Upload your video to your favorite platform and paste the link in the wizard.

schedule.title: Schedule your sessions
schedule.description: Choose fixed days and times, instant start, or both options together.

share.title: Share your link and sell
share.description: The CTAs and simulated chat do the work while you drive traffic.

Home.ctaBannerTitle: Start selling with your first evergreen webinar
Home.ctaBannerSubtitle: Set it up in minutes and let it sell around the clock.
Home.comparisonTitle: Your best webinar shouldn't depend <highlight>on your calendar</highlight>
Home.comparisonSubtitle: A live webinar depends on you being there, at that time, again. An evergreen is recorded once — and keeps selling while you do anything else. Isn't that lovely?
livePoints: Limited by time zone and fixed schedules
evergreenPoints: No repeating the presentation over and over

IntegrationsSettings.title: Integrations
IntegrationsSettings.lockedDescription: These integrations are available on the Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans. Upgrade your plan to connect WeWebinars with Zapier/Make/n8n, add a Meta pixel per webinar, and sync your registrants with Brevo.
IntegrationsSettings.webhooksDescription: Connect WeWebinars to Zapier, Make, n8n, or any tool that receives webhooks. Each event is sent as a POST with a JSON body, signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-WeWebinars-Signature header (you can ignore it if your tool doesn't verify signatures, which is common with Zapier).
IntegrationsSettings.brevoDescription: Everyone who registers for a webinar is automatically added to the Brevo list you choose for that webinar (the "Marketing" step of the wizard) — from there you can use your existing automations and triggers to nurture those leads.
